display.purpose: Used for main page titles and key sections.

body.purpose: Standard reading copy, inputs, and paragraphs.

shadows.name: ambient-light
shadows.purpose: Soft elevations for cards off slate backgrounds in light mode.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Standard action element with tactile borders and snappy active state scaling.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #2563eb; color: #fff; padding: 12px 28px; border-radius: 12px; font-weight: bold; border: none; transition: all 0.2s; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1d4ed8; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: AI Assistant Card
components.description: Subtle border guide card in dark mode containing rotating AI elements.
components.css: .ds-card-ai { background: rgba(15, 30, 53, 0.8); border: 1px solid rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.15); border-radius: 24px; padding: 24px; color: #fff; transition: border-color 0.3s; } .ds-card-ai:hover { border-color: rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.2); }

narrative.overview: This system represents a clean, high-tech engineering aesthetic that blends computer science vibes with institutional structure. It is designed to be highly functional, structured, and formal.
keyCharacteristics: Standardized moving grids, radial vignettes, and glow spots.
Tactile physical-feeling hover offsets and spring curves.
Consistency of Flow across learning and teaching dashboards.

rules.name: The Accent Rarity Rule
rules.body: Vibrant primary tech blue is reserved strictly for interactive indicators, primary call-to-actions, and active state indicators, ensuring they stand out immediately.

rules.name: The No-Literal-Scale Rule
rules.body: Text size styles must avoid raw arbitrary heights to prevent system drift. All sub-label metadata elements default to standard scale values.

rules.name: The Split Dashboard Rule
rules.body: Role-based dashboards implement a responsive two-column template layout: main visual/analytics grid on the left and sticky sidebar on the right.

dos: Do preserve the multi-step progress when a user returns by reading from local storage.
Do use uppercase cyber badges for section tags and status updates.
Do align dashboard cards using full-width headers containing GridBackground elements.
donts: Don't use generic black borders or flat gray highlights.
Don't use standard heavy drop shadows on dark mode cards.
Don't introduce distracting elastic animation styles like animate-bounce on AI guide panels.
